Content: Read the paragraph.

:ibox:	Did you know that languages have families? Sure, languages are not living things, but they can still have parents, siblings, and children. Take Latin for example, a language spoken by many people in Europe and North Africa `text(hundreds)` and `text(hundreds of years)` ago.
